name: Foot placement: two-bone IK on slopes and stairs
body: Plant each foot on the real ground under it: raycast under every foot of the finished pose, solve a two-bone leg (thigh, shin) to reach the ground, lower the hips for the lowest foot, tilt the foot to the surface. Split from the procedural-animation-layer card, whose look-at half is done.
plan: 1. FootPlacement.nox: SolveTwoBone (law of cosines, knee pole toward the character's front) and FootPlacer (per-animator smoothed offsets, swing feet left alone). 2. AnimationSystem.PlaceFeet runs after Update with the collision world; GameHost calls it. 3. Nyx: SetFootPlacement(animator, enabled); CharacterAnimator turns it on. 4. Tests: the solver reaches its target and clamps when out of reach; a placer on stairs plants both feet. Provisional (2026-11-17): rays against static level geometry only; moving platforms are ignored.
acceptance_criteria: A foot on a step stands on the step, not in or above it
A foot that is stepping keeps its animated arc
Unreachable ground stretches the leg no further than its length
definition_of_done: Tests added and `mist run test` passes
